_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Friday April 3rd| 7:21 a.m 

Bonjour Tremblant!

Slope Advisory – Start on the South Side
Due to temperatures affecting the North Side, conditions there are more challenging this morning. We recommend starting your day on the South Side of the mountain, where runs are in better shape. Our mountain crews are working hard to improve conditions across the North Side, so check back for updates as the day progresses.
 

 Lift Operations – Today April 3rd
  • Duncan Express will remain closed.  North Side access will be available via the Expo and Lowell Thomas chairlifts 
  • The Edge side of the mountain will remain closed 
  • Porte du Soleil chairlift will be open today and throughout the Easter weekend
Wishing you a great day on the slopes and a wonderful Easter weekend with family and friends. 

Mountain safety tip of the week: Safe Behavior in Terrain Parks. It's important to always clear landing zones after using features and never stop in these areas to watch others. All terrain park users must also wear a helmet.

Think Ahead
  • Plan before using each feature; your speed and position will directly affect your takeoff and landing. Visualize your move before you drop in.
Look Before You Leap
  • Inspect features before using them, and continue to do so throughout the day.
  • Wait your turn, make sure the landing is clear before you go, and clear the landing area quickly.
Take It Easy
  • Warm up, start with smaller features, and progress as you improve.
  • Perform tricks within your ability level to stay in control.
  • Take lessons to improve your skills.
Respect the Park and Others
  • Respect the park, other users, the Mountain Code of Conduct, and all signage. Respect goes both ways!
Snow fall is recorded daily at 5 a.m from mid-mountain at North Side (550 m / 1,800 ft). This data, based on 24 hours, provides a picture of on-mountain conditions. Actual accumulation may differ from the official report. Be aware of changing conditions. Lifts and trails exist in a mountain environment and may close due to weather, usage and/or special maintenance.
